i believe that is only true for feeds with a minimum number of subscribers, but[@samuelclay](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/samuelclay) can clarify


[samuelclay](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/samuelclay)

That’s correct, a feed needs to have 3 or more subscribers to be visible to other users without the feed address.
